description: Open Drone ID (ASTM F3411 / ASD-STAN EN 4709-002) 25-byte messages and message packs, decoded. input.hex is the frame as broadcast; expected.messages is the decode, or expected.error for a refusal (match on error_contains). Field names are the old decoder's; values the standard reserves for 'unknown' are null.

units.direction_deg: degrees true over the ground (wire: 0-179 + E/W bit)
units.seconds_after_hour: seconds after the full UTC hour (wire: uint16 tenths)
units.accuracy fields: the standard's enum codes, not metres

generated: Expected values computed by knowledge/tools/gen_vectors.py, which runs the old Python implementation (rootxkit/utm @ 484cd228035f) on these inputs. Regenerate rather than edit.
byte_order: little-endian multi-byte fields; bit fields LSB first

cases.why: An empty datagram is refused, not decoded as nothing.

cases.why: A pack declaring a message size other than 25 is refused whole.

cases.why: A pack holds 1 to 9 messages.

cases.why: A pack holds 1 to 9 messages.

cases.name: refuse-pack-inside-a-pack
cases.why: Nesting is refused, as the reference library refuses it.

cases.name: refuse-three-basic-ids

expected.error: too many Basic ID messages in a pack

cases.why: At most two Basic ID messages per pack (ODID_BASIC_ID_MAX_MESSAGES).

cases.name: refuse-two-locations

expected.error: more than one LOCATION message in a pack

cases.why: More than one Location in a pack is refused whole: which one is the aircraft's position would be a guess.

cases.name: refuse-pack-shorter-than-it-says
cases.why: A truncated pack is refused, not decoded from what is there.

cases.name: refuse-truncated-location
cases.why: A 24-byte message is refused: an offset read past the end would be a plausible wrong value.

cases.name: refuse-short-system
cases.why: A short message after a valid type byte is refused.

cases.name: accept-basic-id-and-location-pack
cases.why: The presence pair of the pack refusals: the same builder, valid.

cases.name: skip-self-id
cases.why: Self-ID (free text) and Authentication (needs the maker's keys) are skipped, not misread as another message; an unknown type decodes to nothing.

cases.name: skip-auth
cases.why: Self-ID (free text) and Authentication (needs the maker's keys) are skipped, not misread as another message; an unknown type decodes to nothing.

cases.name: skip-unknown-type-9
cases.why: Self-ID (free text) and Authentication (needs the maker's keys) are skipped, not misread as another message; an unknown type decodes to nothing.

cases.name: position-zero-zero-is-unknown
cases.why: Latitude 0 AND longitude 0 is the standard's 'unknown position': null, never a point in the Gulf of Guinea.

cases.name: latitude-zero-alone-is-a-position
cases.why: Only the pair 0,0 is unknown; latitude 0 with longitude 10 is a real point on the equator.

cases.name: direction-rounding-to-360-is-north
cases.why: An encoder (simulator, lab) must round 359.6 to 360 and wrap it to 0, not write 360 (which encodes as 180 + E/W flag garbage).
